items.caption:
Paul Graham says the first versions of ChatGPT were like an undergrad trying to bluff his way through a paper.

Everyone expected AI to climb slowly from a perfect fly's brain to mice, cats and monkeys. Instead we got a full human, just a terrible one.

Did AI surprise you the same way?

Source: Y Combinator, Paul Graham On Startups, Ambition, and Great Founders. Full video: youtube.com/watch?v=5bxp78i96S8

items.caption:
Paul Graham says the next trillion-dollar company comes from the right founders, not some particular idea.

Asked where the next giant company comes from, the Y Combinator co-founder says its founders will be formidable. Startup ideas are very mutable; the founders are the answer.

Founder or idea: which matters more to you?
